title: Concept: Apache Storm UI is reachable without authentication
description: The Storm summary names every supervisor host and the nimbus endpoint, plus the topology versions. That is the cluster inventory, and the nimbus endpoint it prints is the same one an operator would use to submit topologies.
applicability: Responses from a Storm cluster that serves the UI on a reachable interface.
risk: The caller maps the cluster and learns the nimbus endpoints, then reaches the same services directly.
